reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: getAllMembers is a live route registered at index.ts:77 (non-test caller). Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json contains no trust_assumptions field; entry point is the authenticated REST API with no trusted-source exclusion applicable. Gate 3: src/api/ is explicitly in scope and BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json key_security_concerns explicitly lists 'Discord API rate limiting not implemented in bulk sync', confirming this is a known gap, not out of scope. Code confirmed: members.ts:15-20 fetches all non-deleted members with no LIMIT clause; members.ts:52-80 wraps every guild.members.fetch in a single Promise.all with no concurrency cap or chunking; no MAX_CONCURRENT constant exists anywhere in the codebase. An attacker can trigger this via GET /api/members (authenticated) by issuing repeated requests, causing N simultaneous guild.members.fetch calls (N = all active members), exhausting Discord's per-bot rate limit window (HTTP 429) and causing all member lookups to fail until the window resets. Severity MEDIUM retained: impact is service disruption on this endpoint only; requires valid bearer token.
